primaryText: Only John ever ate any kale for breakfast.
comment: The §2 licensing datum: 'only John' licenses NPIs in its immediate scope despite not being classically DE (ex. 11); formalized as only_isStrawsonDE / only_not_antitone.

primaryText: It's been five years since I saw any bird of prey in this area.
context: Iatridou (p.c.) example relayed by von Fintel.
comment: 'since' licenses NPIs in its complement while failing classical DE (ex. 20); formalized as since_isStrawsonDE / since_not_antitone.

primaryText: Sandy is amazed that Robin ever ate kale.

contrasts.form: Sandy is surprised that Robin ever ate kale.

comment: Adversative attitude licensing datum; complement position is not classically DE (ex. 29).

primaryText: Sandy is sorry that Robin bought any car.

contrasts.form: Sandy regrets that Robin bought any car.

comment: The explanandum for regret_isStrawsonDE: 'sorry' licenses NPIs despite the complement not being classically DE (ex. 30, regret_not_antitone).

primaryText: If John subscribes to any newspaper, he is probably well informed.

contrasts.form: If he has ever told a lie, he must go to confession.
If you had left any later, you would have missed the plane.

comment: Ex. 70a, 70c and 70d bundled (the paper prints no 70b): conditional antecedents license NPIs; DE status depends on the conditional analysis (restrictor vs Stalnaker-Lewis) — idle ordering source: would_isStrawsonDE; genuine ordering source: not_antitone_conditionalNecessity.

primaryText: Emma is the tallest girl to ever win the dance contest.
comment: Superlative licensing datum; the restriction position fails classical DE (ex. 76) but is Strawson-DE (ex. 77) — formalized as superlative_isStrawsonDE.
